sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches src-tauri) for cross-platform reliability.
# Shared SQLite open + busy_timeout plumbing (the `conn` feature) — the same app/CLI-share connection
# setup plandb/skilldb use so a CLI write never races the app's poll on SQLITE_BUSY.
# Shared CLI scaffold: cli_main + resolve_store_path (--db→env→default) + the CmdDoc help system.
# The process-tree RSS sampler behind `bsc errors run`'s cost measurement. `default-features = false`
# with only `system` is the same narrow slice src-tauri takes — it is the process table and nothing
# else, no components/disks/networks — so this stays a cheap dependency on a crate the gate compiles
# The ONE home-dir resolver (#1646) — `--project <key>` and `projects` derive a hub path the same way
# the app's `error_db_path` does, so the CLI and the app can never disagree about which db a key names.
